summary: Completed testing of Employee Master Excel Import feature on Production Attendance page. Backend API endpoints fully functional (7/7 tests passed). Frontend implementation verified via code review - UI components present with correct data-testids. Frontend navigation testing blocked by authentication flow (admin password change requirement).

integration_issues.issue: Admin user requires password change before accessing production module. Direct navigation to /produksi/absensi redirects to login/password change page.
integration_issues.note: This is expected security behavior for default password users. Testing agent unable to complete full UI flow testing due to this authentication requirement.

Backend: Import rejects non-xlsx files with 400 error
Backend: Imported employees appear in GET /api/production/employees list

action_item_for_main_agent: Frontend navigation testing was blocked by admin password change requirement. The feature implementation is correct and backend is fully functional. To enable full E2E testing: 1) Either create a test user with production role that doesn't require password change, OR 2) Update test credentials with a production user that has already changed password. The Excel import feature itself is working correctly - all backend endpoints tested and passed.
